mapper.select: SELECT * FROM article_info WHERE article_id=#{articleId} FOR SHARE

SELECT c.* FROM comment c INNER JOIN article_comment_anchor a ON a.comment_id=c.comment_id WHERE c.article_id=#{articleId} AND c.status=0 AND c.parent_id=0 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC,c.comment_id DESC

SELECT c.* FROM comment c INNER JOIN article_comment_anchor a ON a.comment_id=c.comment_id WHERE c.article_id=#{articleId} AND c.status=0 AND c.parent_id=0 AND c.comment_id IN #{id} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC,c.comment_id DESC
SELECT comment_id,quote_text AS exact,quote_prefix AS prefix,quote_suffix AS suffix, start_offset AS `start`,end_offset AS `end`,content_hash FROM article_comment_anchor WHERE comment_id IN #{id}
